scope: Phase 1 and 2 integration: the composed core, Postgres persistence, identity, practice, settings, audit, API and MCP. This is not full product acceptance; 49 of 52 criteria remain pending globally.

pending_notes.AC-001: Phase case passes: one Linux Compose up with no edits reaches setup, two-factor and a ready install. Clean Docker Desktop (Windows/macOS) installation is release acceptance and has not run.
pending_notes.AC-002: Phase case passes: 99 of 427 contract operations are mounted on /api/v1 and /mcp, all fail closed, and the spec validates. Billing, trust, calendar, files, editor, Doc Tender, modules and users are not built; GET /api/v1/reports/matters and GET /api/v1/matters/{matter_id}/conflict-checks are served but absent from the contract.
pending_notes.AC-003: Phase case passes for list, search, widget, report, screens, API and MCP. Files, calendar, billing and trust surfaces of a walled matter are not built; module include rows are pending.
pending_notes.AC-004: Phase case passes: the accountant reads the trust and AR reports and every practice, settings and area write is refused. Billing and trust records and their write paths are not built.
pending_notes.AC-009: Phase case passes with an invoice written into the practice store as the billing wave's stand-in; real billing and trust ledgers are not built.
pending_notes.AC-018: Audit half passes: every write in identity, settings and practice reaches the append-only audit_log with actor and source, and Compose runs the core as a non-superuser role that cannot change it. Backup download, S3 and network-path copies and restore of a running core are not demonstrated end to end in this assignment.
pending_notes.AC-020: Phase case passes for matter number, phone and invoice number in each scope and All, and walls hide results; invoices come from the stand-in store and file-text search is pending (files).
pending_notes.AC-023: Phase case passes for reopen with reason, restored status and timeline; the zero-fee marker is covered by the practice suite, AR aging over real billing data is pending.
pending_notes.AC-024: Phase case passes for history old/new values and attorney-only redaction; the events table is still mutable by the application role (AC-024-F4).
pending_notes.AC-029: Phase case passes: PRD defaults are registry settings listed on admin page tabs, a change applies on the next request, is logged with old and new values, and Reset restores it. Settings read by modules that are not built cannot yet show their effect.

ci.placeholder_to_replace: The existing 'API bootstrap validation' job exits 0 when api/ is absent; the proposal replaces it with 'API contract tests'.
ci.blocker: Lane workers cannot change .github/. The exact product-ci.yml change is in the PR body under 'Proposed CI change'. The integration lead must land it through a reviewed control PR. Until then the three required checks are missing on GitHub, and this report's pass status covers local runs only.
ci.local_environment_note: Local runs at the tested revision used Docker postgres:17 servers and a PostgreSQL 18 client for the backup test (postgresql-client-17 was not installable on this VM), plus Python 3.14. CI pins Postgres 17 client and Python 3.12. The supervisor image build at the tested revision reused Docker layer cache because no supervisor input changed.

simplification.review: Folded duplicate identity error mapping into one shared() table; reused Memory behind Durable instead of a second store; reused the contract tool catalog for bearer scopes, MCP tools/list and dispatch; kept the Go standard library and existing pgx/goose dependencies (no new modules).

this_run.review: One unit type and a Begin method on Durable reuse the existing commit path; Service.unit is a two-line optional-interface check, so Memory and test stores are unchanged. Practice ceiling 1 is rewritten in place, not added.

status_reason: Every assigned phase case and every local test passes at the tested revision, but the assignment also requires CI to expose Core tests, API contract tests and QA harness tests. Those jobs are not in .github/workflows/product-ci.yml, and lane workers cannot change .github/. Status becomes pass once the integration lead lands the proposed workflow change and those jobs pass on the published head.

review_fixes.finding: Codex checkpoint on 16f9c87, P1 internal/practice/durable.go: one service mutation committed as several transactions, so a failed audit_log append could leave an unaudited change, and check-then-write was not serialized.
review_fixes.fix: Durable.Begin unit of work; every exported mutating practice Service method runs in one unit, which commits its records and audit rows in one transaction or reloads on error.
tests: TestServiceMutationIsOneTransaction (fails with the unit disabled; passes with it)
TestConcurrentClosesSerialize (serialization guard; it also passed with the unit disabled because the race window is small, so it is not proof of the fix)
